Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 040. 矩阵中最大的矩形

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int h[210];
    int l[210], r[210];
    int maximalRectangle(vector<string>& matrix) {
        int n = matrix.size();
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        int m = matrix[0].size();
        int ans = 0;
        stack<int> st;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                h[j] = (matrix[i][j] == '1' ? h[j] + 1 : 0);
                while (st.size() && h[j] <= h[st.top()]) {
                    ans = max(ans, (j - l[st.top()] - 1) * h[st.top()]);
                    st.pop();
                }
                if (st.size())
                    l[j] = st.top();
                else
                    l[j] = -1;
                st.push(j);
            }
            while (st.size()) {
                ans = max(ans, (m - 1 - l[st.top()]) * h[st.top()]);
                st.pop();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
